failures.criterion: C2: on a closed issue, a margin comment on one of its documents posts (the closed document offers Comment on a text selection)
failures.evidence: Red test packages/dispatch/e2e/closed-issue-posting.e2e.ts:278 'a margin comment on a spec whose issue closed while the page was open posts with its quote', commit 8cbdfa9d5b46. Command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- --project=chromium --project=iphone e2e/closed-issue-posting.e2e.ts. Result at code head adb397f9: chromium passes; iphone fails at :300 expect(actionBar(page).getByRole('button')).toHaveText(['Comment']), received [] (the bar never shows). Same page after a reload offers Comment. Cause as read: packages/proof-editor/src/dispatch-action-bar.ts:193-197 sets editorLostFocus on focusout for a touch selection; the editor's switch to contenteditable=false when the issue closes blurs it, and a read-only element never takes focusin again (:188-190), so :255 and :287-296 hide the bar for every later touch selection. A person with the spec open and focused on a phone when the merge closes the issue cannot comment on a quote until they reload.

failures.criterion: C2 and the spec's 'reopening still works': a closed issue's page, once the issue is reopened from it, takes edits to its document again (fix in place per the controller, under dispatch://INFRA-49/ask/2d080aec-ce9a-4c7c-a235-ae998d2b0830)
failures.evidence: Red test packages/dispatch/e2e/closed-issue-posting.e2e.ts:321 'a spec opened while its issue was closed takes edits once the issue is reopened from its page', commit dac91dcef8af. Command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- --project=chromium --project=iphone e2e/closed-issue-posting.e2e.ts. Result at code head adb397f9: fails in both projects at :335 expect(documentEditor(page)).toHaveAttribute('contenteditable','true'), received 'false', after the closed banner is gone. The same sequence as a throwaway probe at main bc307fb5 gave the same result (pre-existing). Cause as read: a closed issue's socket is admitted read-only, ProofDocument's onAdmission stores schemaReadOnly=true (packages/dispatch/web/src/features/doc/ProofDocument.tsx onAdmission), and on reopen editorAccess(false, true) answers 'read'; nothing re-reads the admission or reconnects the socket when the issue reopens. The fix the controller named: the document page re-reads its admission (or reconnects) when the issue reopens.
